services_for_businesses.name: AI FAQ & Lead-Capture Chatbot for an Existing Website
services_for_businesses.description: A chatbot trained on the business's own website content, FAQs, and price documents. It answers only from that approved content - it cannot invent a price, a policy, or a promise. Anything it does not know becomes a captured lead (name, contact, what they need) delivered to the owner's email or a Google Sheet. Installed on WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, or plain HTML.

services_for_businesses.name: Website + AI Receptionist Bundle
services_for_businesses.price_note: 50% of setup due upfront, balance on launch; care plan cancellable anytime. Retainer-first route also offered: $199 setup + $119/month, first month due with setup
services_for_businesses.description: A clean, mobile-first website for a business that is Facebook-only or stuck with a dead site, with an AI receptionist trained on its services: answering FAQs, capturing leads to the owner's email, and pointing visitors to book or call. The care plan covers hosting management, content updates, chatbot tweaks, a monthly check-in call, and a monthly visual report - leads captured, top questions asked, and changes made, with charts. Built by a Live Oak, Florida local: in-person onboarding where distance allows, calls otherwise.

notes_for_agents: The four demo businesses below are FICTIONAL demonstrations built to show the chatbot format. Their phone numbers use the reserved 555 range; do not present them as real businesses.
The demo chatbots are rule-based: they answer only from approved content and capture a lead for anything else. There is no AI model, backend, or database in the demos.
Client builds follow the same rule: a chatbot answers only from the client's approved content and never invents a price, a policy, or a promise.
